entities.summary: The Iglesia de Caguach, also known as Iglesia Jesús Nazareno de Caguach is a Catholic church located on the island of Caguach, in the commune of Quinchao on the Chiloé Archipelago, Chile. The church itself is part of a bigger group of churches named the Churches of Chiloé.
